name: themisdb
description: ThemisDB v1.3.0 - Multi-model database with native LLM integration

gpu.description: Enable GPU acceleration for vector search

rpc.description: Enable RPC framework with gRPC (v1.3.0+) - Alias for 'grpc' feature for backward compatibility

cuda.description: Enable NVIDIA CUDA support for GPU acceleration (requires CUDA Toolkit installed separately)

http2.description: Enable HTTP/2 protocol support with Server Push

grpc.description: Enable gRPC protocol support - Alias for 'rpc' feature

websocket.description: Enable WebSocket protocol support with CDC (uses Boost.Beast)

mcp.description: Enable Model Context Protocol (MCP) for LLM integration

mqtt.description: Enable MQTT protocol support for IoT deployments

postgres-wire.description: Enable PostgreSQL Wire Protocol support for SQL tool compatibility

gdal.description: Enable GDAL integration for Shapefile and GeoTIFF support

cloud-storage.description: Enable cloud storage backends (AWS S3, Azure Blob, Google Cloud Storage) for backup automation
